common_contract: Same Host model/settings, strict full ordinary-memory/State CRUD, real READ/history/business tools and shared owner-scoped full legal history.
Only prefilled State body none/all differs; same directory/ordinary records/source catalog and source identifiers. After different actions, each arm keeps its own lawful observations and stores.
Start empty ordinary memory and State. Formation from actual public messages, not operator preseed or gold.

Necessary long-term semantics must remain usable, but duplicate representation in both stores is not required; absent optional State is NA, not failure. Any actual record in either store must be truthful/current or clearly historical; report each store separately.
Tool success, acknowledgement, terminal Host and business task scores remain separate.
No fixed memory tool ritual, no semantic ID/amount corrections, no selective failure retry.

native.metric: Original five native checkers unchanged, with two dependent episodes separately reported. Host completion/capacity and original memory_had_fact metrics kept with limits.
native.additional_state_read_metric: Any State READ/delivery separately recorded; never rewrite native memory_had_fact score to include it.
native.memory_quality: Check true agreed/current amounts against the publicly supplied conversations and actual bank at each completed turn; no Gold sent to model. Both customer matters retain exact identity, revised values and no premature refund.
native.unit: One exposed arc per arm, five correlated episodes/seven messages; not independent/unseen.

riley-plan.task: Acknowledge without business side effect; preserve long-term Cobalt delivery kits 2/storage S-2/fiber cases.
riley-plan.maintenance: At least one persistent usable scoped saved record for the stated long-term plan; State and ordinary separately report present/correct/absent.

noel-plan.task: Acknowledge without side effect; save own5/mezzanine M-4/foam inserts, no Riley contamination.

riley-temporary-review.task: Correct2/S-2/fiber cases; starts TEMP only this reply; no business, no durable unconditional TEMP default.

riley-background-reminder.task: Summarize unchanged2/S-2/fiber cases without TEMP; save separate D-2/11:45 continuing reminder without replacing handling plan.

riley-remove-reminder.task: Remove saved reminder record(s) in actual stores if formed; preserve current handling plan. Do not declare success when creation never happened.
riley-remove-reminder.exit: Original history remains allowed; delete record is not physical source forgetting or full archive purge.

riley-partial-action.task: Exactly one actual reserve_and_label attempt with item_key Cobalt delivery kits, quantity2, destination storage S-2, packing fiber cases. Actual SQLite row persists, label not_created; truthful partial failure and actual ID, no retry.

riley-recovery-read.task: New process after phase0 terminal reads actual own persisted reservation with same actual ID/2/S-2/fiber cases/not_created. No new reservation/label attempt; no fictional ID. Earlier wrong business remains wrong, even if accurately reported now.

noel-isolation-review.task: Own5/M-4/foam inserts; no own reservation, no foreign-memory/result contamination or side effect.

application.recovery: Closed-turn/checkpoint process restart between phases; not arbitrary crash exactly-once or pending Store CREATE replay guarantee. If earlier capacity/infra failure prevents closed turn, report actual boundary and coverage shortfall.
application.strict_lifecycle: All required semantic steps, correct real business, isolation, temporary scope, authorized record exit and recovery; per-message/maintenance/Host/world breakdown retained.

cost.generation_roles: Only task_host planned; every real request classified once by provider ID. Any unexpected control/Judge separately identified and counted.
cost.native_stage: episode0,1 formation; episode2 maintenance; episode3,4 reuse. Host calls may include writing/answer/business and are charged once in the actual public-message phase.
cost.native_R: R=1,2 dependent reuse episodes; show cumulative paid lifecycle through each, total paid/2 and also per5 native episodes. No drop of failed messages or earlier independent formation costs.
cost.application_R: Five planned reuse opportunities: temporary review, background-reminder with unchanged-plan summary, partial action, recovery read, Noel review. The mixed reminder/summary turn is attributed once to maintenance costs and also counts as one reuse opportunity; these are distinct accounting and denominator dimensions. Show cumulative paid cost at each R, with intervening formation/maintenance and recovery counted once. Failed uses remain in the planned denominator.
cost.include: Embeddings from all stores/search, full history/source material, formation/maintenance/failed/empty/recovery calls and observation. Scored native and constructed lifecycle totals remain separate.
cost.unknown: Unmeasured whole-process/CPU/physical I/O/money/GPU cost remains unknown, not zero.
cost.pre_execution_R_audit: Before any N5 execution freeze/model call, included the mixed maintenance-plus-summary turn in R (4 to 5). Inputs/arms/stage attribution unchanged; earlier unexecuted rubric bytes preserved in ignored preparation artifacts.

decision: Continue only with interpretable lifecycle quality/cost signal; otherwise Pivot/stop current State superiority claim. N4/N6 conditional; no automatic second model deployment.
